pinyin: bái fà rén sòng hēi fà rén
literal: white · haired · person · see off · black · haired · person

meaning.en: An old person burying a younger one: parents outliving their child.
meaning.zh: 年老的人为年轻人送葬，指父母在子女之后去世的悲痛。

equivalents: the tragedy of outliving one's child

examples.zh: 白发人送黑发人，是人生最大的悲哀。
examples.en: For the white-haired to send off the black-haired is life's greatest sorrow.

examples.zh: 老两口经历了白发人送黑发人的打击。
examples.en: The old couple suffered the blow of burying their own child.

examples.zh: 看到白发人送黑发人的场面，围观者都落泪了。
examples.en: The onlookers wept at the sight of an old man burying his son.

usage.en: A set phrase in news about accidents and disasters; solemn.
usage.zh: 常见于事故、灾难报道，语气沉痛。

pinyin: yī ér zài, zài ér sān
literal: once · and · again, again · and · three-times

meaning.en: Once, then again, then a third time: repeatedly, often used of something that should not recur.
meaning.zh: 一次又一次，指多次重复。多含不满，指不应重复的事一再发生。

examples.zh: 他一而再，再而三地违反规定。
examples.en: He broke the rules again and again.

examples.zh: 我一而再再而三地提醒过你。
examples.en: I've reminded you again and again.

examples.zh: 对方一而再，再而三地拖延付款。
examples.en: The other side has delayed payment time after time.

usage.en: Adverbial; usually with disapproval; the idiom 事不过三 is related.
usage.zh: 作状语，多含不满。

pinyin: yī fēn gēng yún, yī fēn shōu huò
literal: one · portion · ploughing · weeding, one · portion · harvest

meaning.en: For every bit of effort there is a bit of reward.
meaning.zh: 付出多少努力，就有多少收获。

examples.zh: 一分耕耘，一分收获，努力总会有回报。
examples.en: As you sow so shall you reap; effort always pays off.

examples.zh: 一分耕耘一分收获，学习没有捷径。
examples.en: There are no shortcuts in study; what you reap equals what you sow.

examples.zh: 他坚信一分耕耘，一分收获。
examples.en: He firmly believes that each measure of effort brings a measure of reward.

usage.en: Encouraging; common in school and work settings.
usage.zh: 勉励语，常见于学习和工作场合。

synonyms: 春种一粒粟，秋收万颗子

pinyin: xīn dòng bù rú xíng dòng
literal: heart · stirs · not · as good as · action

meaning.en: Being tempted is not as good as acting: don't just think about it, do it.
meaning.zh: 光想不如去做。鼓励人立刻行动。

examples.zh: 想减肥就开始吧，心动不如行动。
examples.en: If you want to lose weight, start now; doing beats dreaming.

examples.zh: 心动不如行动，这个周末就去旅行吧。
examples.en: Don't just think about it: go travelling this weekend.

examples.zh: 心动不如行动，赶紧报名吧！
examples.en: Don't hesitate, sign up now!

usage.en: Common in advertising and social media; casual.
usage.zh: 常见于广告和网络用语，口语。

pinyin: yì gāo rén dǎn dà
literal: skill · high · person · gall · big

meaning.en: Those with great skill are daring.
meaning.zh: 本领高强的人胆子大。

examples.zh: 艺高人胆大，他敢单独攀登那座山峰。
examples.en: A highly skilled person is bold; he dared to climb that peak alone.

examples.zh: 老师傅艺高人胆大，不用保护就修好了电线。
examples.en: The old master, bold with his skill, fixed the wiring without protection.

examples.zh: 艺高人胆大，但也不能掉以轻心。
examples.en: Skill gives boldness, but one must not be careless.

usage.en: Usually praising; sometimes a warning against recklessness.
usage.zh: 多含称赞，有时也提醒勿轻率。

synonyms: 撑死胆大的，饿死胆小的
没有三两三，不敢上梁山

pinyin: yī tiáo dào zǒu dào hēi
literal: one · road · walk · to · dark
natural: stick to one road until dark

meaning.en: To stick to one path no matter what, however wrong it proves.
meaning.zh: 认定一条路就走到底，不肯回头改变。多含贬义，指固执不知变通。

equivalents: stubbornly stick to a doomed course

examples.zh: 别一条道走到黑，撞了南墙就该回头。
examples.en: Don't stick to one road to the dark; turn back when you hit a wall.

examples.zh: 他这人认死理，一条道走到黑。
examples.en: He's stubborn and never changes course.

examples.zh: 投资不能一条道走到黑，要分散风险。
examples.en: In investing, don't stick to one road regardless; spread your risk.

usage.en: Predicate; often advice or criticism.
usage.zh: 作谓语，多用于劝告或批评。

pinyin: yī fā bù kě shōu shí
literal: once · start · not · can · gather · up

meaning.en: Once something starts, it gets out of hand and cannot be stopped.
meaning.zh: 事情一旦发生就无法控制和收拾。

examples.zh: 矛盾一旦激化，就会一发不可收拾。
examples.en: Once the conflict escalates, it will spiral out of control.

examples.zh: 他玩起游戏来一发不可收拾，一玩就是一整天。
examples.en: Once he starts a game he can't stop and plays all day.

examples.zh: 这场风波一发不可收拾。
examples.en: This storm got completely out of hand.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; also of enjoyable habits that get out of hand.
usage.zh: 作谓语或状语，也可用于难以停下来的爱好。

pinyin: shí nián shù mù, bǎi nián shù rén
literal: ten · years · plant · trees, hundred · years · nurture · people

meaning.en: It takes ten years to grow a tree but a hundred to rear a person: education is a long-term task.
meaning.zh: 培养树木需要十年，培养人才需要百年。比喻培养人才不是一朝一夕的事。

equivalents: education is the work of generations

examples.zh: 十年树木，百年树人，教育来不得急功近利。
examples.en: Ten years to grow a tree, a hundred to rear people; education can't be rushed for quick results.

examples.zh: 十年树木，百年树人，人才培养要有长远规划。
examples.en: Cultivating talent requires long-term planning.

examples.zh: 老师常说十年树木，百年树人。
examples.en: The teacher often says that growing people takes a century.

story.en: Guanzi: 'For a year's plan, nothing like planting grain; for a ten-year plan, nothing like planting trees; for a lifetime plan, nothing like nurturing people' (一年之计，莫如树谷；十年之计，莫如树木；终身之计，莫如树人).
story.zh: 《管子·权修》：“一年之计，莫如树谷；十年之计，莫如树木；终身之计，莫如树人。一树一获者，谷也；一树十获者，木也；一树百获者，人也。”

date.zh: 战国至西汉 · 前4—前1世纪
date.en: Warring States to Western Han, 4th–1st c. BC

usage.en: Used in talk of education and talent; formal.
usage.zh: 谈论教育与人才培养时使用，书面语。

synonyms: 一年之计，莫如树谷；十年之计，莫如树木；终身之计，莫如树人

text: 勿以恶小而为之，勿以善小而不为
pinyin: wù yǐ è xiǎo ér wéi zhī, wù yǐ shàn xiǎo ér bù wéi
literal: do not · because · evil · small · do · it, do not · because · good · small · not · do
natural: no act is too small, good or bad

meaning.en: Do not commit a wrong because it is small, and do not neglect a good deed because it is small.
meaning.zh: 不要因为坏事小就去做，也不要因为好事小就不做。

equivalents: no good deed is too small, no evil is trivial

examples.zh: 勿以恶小而为之，勿以善小而不为，做人要从小事做起。
examples.en: Do not do wrong because it's small, nor skip good because it's small; start with the small things.

examples.zh: 勿以善小而不为，捐一块钱也是爱心。
examples.en: Don't neglect good because it's small; even one yuan shows kindness.

examples.zh: 家长教育孩子，勿以恶小而为之。
examples.en: Parents teach children never to do wrong, however minor.

origin.source: 《三国志·蜀书·先主传》裴松之注

story.en: Liu Bei's deathbed edict to his son, as quoted in Pei Songzhi's commentary on the Records of the Three Kingdoms: 'Do not do evil because it is small; do not neglect good because it is small' (勿以恶小而为之，勿以善小而不为).
story.zh: 《三国志·蜀书·先主传》裴松之注引《诸葛亮集》载刘备遗诏：“勿以恶小而为之，勿以善小而不为。惟贤惟德，能服于人。”

usage.en: Maxim for moral cultivation; frequently on posters and in schools.
usage.zh: 修身格言，常见于标语和学校。

pinyin: tiān xià xīng wáng, pǐ fū yǒu zé
literal: world · rise · fall, common · man · has · responsibility
natural: everyone is responsible for the nation's fate

meaning.en: Every ordinary person bears responsibility for the rise and fall of the nation.
meaning.zh: 国家的兴盛和衰亡，每个普通人都有责任。

equivalents: everyone is responsible for the fate of the nation

examples.zh: 天下兴亡，匹夫有责，青年要有家国情怀。
examples.en: Everyone is responsible for the nation's rise and fall; young people should care for their country.

examples.zh: 他常说天下兴亡，匹夫有责。
examples.en: He often says every common person is responsible for the nation's fate.

examples.zh: 天下兴亡匹夫有责，每个人都要尽一份力。
examples.en: The fate of the nation rests on everyone, so everyone should do their part.

story.en: Gu Yanwu's Rizhilu (Zhengshi) holds that 'the common man, however lowly, shares responsibility for protecting the world' (保天下者，匹夫之贱与有责焉耳矣); the four-character wording in this form was popularised later, notably by Liang Qichao.
story.zh: 顾炎武《日知录·正始》有“保天下者，匹夫之贱与有责焉耳矣”之意，后经梁启超等人概括，才广为流传为“天下兴亡，匹夫有责”。

usage.en: Patriotic slogan; formal.
usage.zh: 爱国口号，书面语。

text: 公说公有理，婆说婆有理
pinyin: gōng shuō gōng yǒu lǐ, pó shuō pó yǒu lǐ
literal: father-in-law · says · father-in-law · has · reason, mother-in-law · says · mother-in-law · has · reason
natural: each side claims to be right

meaning.en: Each side thinks it is right and has its own reasons.
meaning.zh: 双方各自坚持自己有理，难以分出是非。

equivalents: there are two sides to every story
each party argues it's in the right

examples.zh: 两人争吵不休，公说公有理，婆说婆有理，我也不知道听谁的。
examples.en: They argue endlessly, each claiming to be right, and I don't know whom to believe.

examples.zh: 公说公有理，婆说婆有理，裁判很难判。
examples.en: Each side has its reasons, which makes the referee's job hard.

examples.zh: 这个案子公说公有理，让人难以决断。
examples.en: In this case each side has its own argument, making it hard to decide.

usage.en: Describes a dispute with no clear right or wrong.
usage.zh: 形容双方各执一词的争执。

pinyin: chūn wǔ qiū dòng
literal: spring · keep warm · autumn · be chilly
natural: dress warmly in spring, lightly in autumn

meaning.en: In spring keep wrapped up; in autumn do not bundle up too soon: a folk health maxim.
meaning.zh: 春天不要急于减衣服，秋天不要急于添衣服，这样有利于健康。

equivalents: don't shed layers too soon in spring
a folk health tip about dressing for the seasons

examples.zh: 春捂秋冻，天气刚暖和先别脱厚衣服。
examples.en: Wrap up in spring and be a little chilly in autumn; don't take off thick clothes just because it's warm.

examples.zh: 奶奶常说春捂秋冻，不会生病。
examples.en: Grandma says 'keep warm in spring, a little cold in autumn' and you won't fall ill.

examples.zh: 春捂秋冻是老祖宗的养生经验。
examples.en: Keeping warm in spring and cool in autumn is our ancestors' health wisdom.

usage.en: Folk saying of health care; casual.
usage.zh: 民间养生谚语，口语。

text: 救人一命，胜造七级浮屠
pinyin: jiù rén yī mìng, shèng zào qī jí fú tú
literal: save · person · one · life, surpass · build · seven · storey · pagoda
natural: saving a life beats building a pagoda

meaning.en: Saving one life is better than building a seven-tiered pagoda.
meaning.zh: 救一个人的性命，功德胜过建造七层宝塔。形容救人性命的功德极大。

equivalents: saving a life is the greatest good deed
saving a life earns more merit than building a pagoda

examples.zh: 救人一命，胜造七级浮屠，这位医生救过无数人。
examples.en: Saving a life is worth more than building a seven-tiered pagoda; this doctor has saved countless people.

examples.zh: 救人一命，胜造七级浮屠，他毫不犹豫地跳下水。
examples.en: Saving a life beats building a pagoda, so he jumped in without a second thought.

examples.zh: 她常说救人一命就是最大的功德。
examples.en: She often says saving a life is the greatest merit.

usage.en: Used in praise of rescue and medical work; Buddhist flavour.
usage.zh: 用于赞扬救人和医务工作，带佛教色彩。

pinyin: sān shí liù jì, zǒu wéi shàng jì
literal: thirty-six · stratagems, flee · is · best · stratagem

meaning.en: Of the thirty-six stratagems, retreat is best: when the situation is hopeless, withdrawing is the wise choice.
meaning.zh: 三十六种计谋中，逃走是最好的办法。形容形势不利时，退避是最好的选择。

equivalents: discretion is the better part of valour

examples.zh: 敌众我寡，三十六计，走为上计。
examples.en: The enemy outnumbers us; of the thirty-six stratagems, retreat is best.

examples.zh: 三十六计走为上计，他见势不妙溜走了。
examples.en: He saw it was going badly and slipped away: of the thirty-six stratagems, retreat is best.

examples.zh: 三十六计，我们还是走为上计吧。
examples.en: Of all the stratagems, retreat is the best; let's get out of here.

story.en: Book of Southern Qi: Wang Jingze's rebellion was dismissed with the remark 'Of Lord Tan's thirty-six stratagems, flight is the best' (檀公三十六策，走是上计).
story.zh: 《南齐书·王敬则传》：“檀公三十六策，走是上计，汝父子唯应急走耳。”

usage.en: Often humorous when someone slips away.
usage.zh: 常用于幽默地表示溜走。

pinyin: chā zhī háo lí, miù yǐ qiān lǐ
literal: differ · by · hair · fraction, error · reaches · thousand · li
natural: a hair's breadth off at the start, a thousand li wrong at the end

meaning.en: A tiny error at the start leads to a huge one in the end.
meaning.zh: 开始时只差一点点，结果会错得很远。

equivalents: a miss is as good as a mile
a small error can lead to a big mistake

examples.zh: 科学实验差之毫厘，谬以千里，一定要严谨。
examples.en: In science a hair's breadth of error can mean a thousand li of difference; be rigorous.

examples.zh: 差之毫厘，谬以千里，这个小数点一定要核对。
examples.en: A fraction off now becomes a mile off later; check this decimal point.

examples.zh: 方向偏了一点，失之毫厘，谬以千里。
examples.en: The direction is slightly off; a tiny miss at the start becomes a huge mistake.

story.en: The Book of Rites, citing the Yi, says the gentleman is careful at the start: 'A hair's breadth of difference leads to a thousand-li error' (差若毫厘，缪以千里).
story.zh: 《礼记·经解》：“《易》曰：‘君子慎始，差若毫厘，缪以千里。’”

usage.en: Warning about carelessness in details; also in the form 失之毫厘，谬以千里.
usage.zh: 提醒细节不可马虎，也说“失之毫厘，谬以千里”。

pinyin: shèng míng zhī xià, qí shí nán fù
literal: great · fame · 's · under, its · reality · hard · to match

meaning.en: Under a great reputation, the reality is hard to live up to.
meaning.zh: 名气很大的人，实际才能往往难以与名声相称。

equivalents: hard to live up to one's reputation
the reality can't match the hype

examples.zh: 盛名之下，其实难副，他的第二部作品令人失望。
examples.en: Beneath great fame the reality is hard to match: his second work was disappointing.

examples.zh: 盛名之下，其实难副，这家餐厅名气太大了。
examples.en: This restaurant's reputation is bigger than its substance.

examples.zh: 盛名之下其实难副，他一直感到压力。
examples.en: Under great fame it's hard to live up to expectations, and he's always under pressure.

story.en: Book of the Later Han, biography of Huang Qiong: Li Gu warned him that 'under a great name, the reality is hard to match' (盛名之下，其实难副).
story.zh: 《后汉书·黄琼传》载李固遗书黄琼：“盛名之下，其实难副。”

usage.en: Can criticise inflated fame or express modest awareness; formal.
usage.zh: 可批评名不副实，也可用作自谦。

pinyin: zhēng yī zhī yǎn bì yī zhī yǎn
literal: open · one · eye · close · one · eye

meaning.en: To pretend not to notice something, to be deliberately lenient.
meaning.zh: 对不合规矩的事装作没看见，不去计较。

examples.zh: 老师对这点小错误睁一只眼闭一只眼。
examples.en: The teacher turned a blind eye to this small mistake.

examples.zh: 管理员睁一眼闭一眼，违规停车越来越多。
examples.en: The warden looked the other way, and illegal parking grew.

examples.zh: 邻里之间，有些事睁一只眼闭一只眼就过去了。
examples.en: Among neighbours, some things can be let pass by turning a blind eye.

usage.en: Predicate; neutral to mildly critical.
usage.zh: 作谓语，中性略带批评。

synonyms: 木匠吊线——睁只眼，闭只眼
antonyms: 鸡蛋里挑骨头——百般挑剔

pinyin: chī dà guō fàn
literal: eat · big · pot · rice

meaning.en: To share rewards equally regardless of how much each person contributes.
meaning.zh: 不论贡献大小，大家得到同样的报酬。比喻平均主义。

examples.zh: 企业不能再吃大锅饭，要多劳多得。
examples.en: Firms can't go on with equal pay for all; reward must match work.

examples.zh: 吃大锅饭的日子让人缺乏积极性。
examples.en: The days of eating from one big pot left people with no motivation.

examples.zh: 团队吃大锅饭，干得好的人也没动力。
examples.en: When the team eats from one pot, even good workers lose their drive.

usage.en: Mainly about economic systems and pay.
usage.zh: 多用于经济制度和薪酬。

pinyin: zuò xiǎo dòng zuò
literal: do · small · movements
natural: play dirty tricks behind the scenes

meaning.en: To make petty, underhand moves behind someone's back.
meaning.zh: 在背后搞不正当的小花招。也指考试等场合的小动作。

examples.zh: 他表面上很客气，背地里却做小动作。
examples.en: He's polite to your face but plays tricks behind your back.

examples.zh: 考试的时候不要做小动作。
examples.en: Don't try any tricks during the exam.

examples.zh: 有人在会上做小动作。
examples.en: Someone was playing tricks at the meeting.

usage.en: Verb phrase; the idiom may take 搞/耍 ('play tricks').
usage.zh: 动宾结构，也可说“搞小动作”。

pinyin: shuō fēng liáng huà
literal: say · cool · breeze · words

meaning.en: To make sarcastic or unsympathetic comments from the sidelines.
meaning.zh: 站在一旁说讽刺、不负责任的话。

equivalents: make snide remarks from the sidelines

examples.zh: 别在旁边说风凉话，过来帮帮忙。
examples.en: Stop making snide remarks from the sidelines and come and help.

examples.zh: 大家正忙着，他却在一边说风凉话。
examples.en: Everyone was busy, while he stood aside passing sarcastic comments.

examples.zh: 遇到困难，有人帮忙，有人说风凉话。
examples.en: Faced with difficulties, some help and some sneer.

usage.en: Verb phrase; spoken, critical.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，口语，带批评。

pinyin: fǎn yǎo yī kǒu
literal: turn · bite · one · mouthful
natural: turn on someone and accuse them

meaning.en: To accuse your accuser, or turn on the person who helped you.
meaning.zh: 自己做错了事，反而诬陷指责对方。也指忘恩负义，转而攻击恩人。

examples.zh: 他犯了错还反咬一口，说是我害了他。
examples.en: He made the mistake and then turned on me, claiming I'd harmed him.

examples.zh: 你帮了他，他反咬一口，真是白眼狼。
examples.en: You helped him and he turned and bit you: a real ingrate.

examples.zh: 小心坏人被抓后反咬一口。
examples.en: Beware that a crook may counter-accuse once caught.

usage.en: Verb phrase; often with 倒打一耙-type contexts.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，语义与“倒打一耙”相近。

synonyms: 猪八戒耍把式——倒打一耙

pinyin: fàng xià bāo fu
literal: put · down · bundle

meaning.en: To drop a mental burden and stop worrying.
meaning.zh: 把思想上的负担去掉，轻装前进。

examples.zh: 放下包袱，轻装上阵，你一定能发挥好。
examples.en: Drop the baggage and go in light; you'll perform well.

examples.zh: 他终于放下包袱，重新开始。
examples.en: He finally dropped the burden and started afresh.

examples.zh: 别总想着过去的失败，要放下包袱。
examples.en: Don't dwell on past failures; let go of the burden.

usage.en: Often used of mental pressure; the idiom may include 思想, 心理 before 包袱.
usage.zh: 常指心理负担，中间可插入“思想、心理”等词。

pinyin: guò yì bù qù
literal: pass · mind · not · go

meaning.en: To feel apologetic or uneasy, e.g. for causing trouble or accepting too much kindness.
meaning.zh: 心里感到不安，觉得对不起人。

examples.zh: 让你白跑一趟，我真过意不去。
examples.en: I feel bad that you made a wasted trip.

examples.zh: 你这么客气，我实在过意不去。
examples.en: You're so kind that I feel quite uncomfortable.

examples.zh: 麻烦了你这么久，心里很过意不去。
examples.en: I feel bad about troubling you for so long.

usage.en: Predicate; polite expression of apology or thanks.
usage.zh: 作谓语，礼貌地表示歉意或感谢。

pinyin: tàng shǒu shān yù
literal: scalding · hand · sweet potato

meaning.en: A problem that is difficult and risky to handle and which nobody wants to take on.
meaning.zh: 比喻棘手而又不愿意接手的难题。

examples.zh: 这个烂摊子是个烫手山芋，谁也不想接。
examples.en: This mess is a hot potato nobody wants to take over.

examples.zh: 他把这个烫手山芋扔给了新同事。
examples.en: He tossed the hot potato to his new colleague.

examples.zh: 接手那个亏损的项目，无异于接了个烫手山芋。
examples.en: Taking over the loss-making project is like picking up a hot potato.

usage.en: Noun; often with 接手, 扔, 甩.
usage.zh: 名词，常与“接手、扔、甩”搭配。

pinyin: huā quán xiù tuǐ
literal: flowery · fists · embroidered · legs

meaning.en: Showy martial moves with no real fighting power; style over substance.
meaning.zh: 看起来好看却不实用的拳脚功夫。比喻只有好看的架势，没有真本领。

examples.zh: 他的武术只是花拳绣腿，真打起来不堪一击。
examples.en: His martial arts are all show and fall apart in a real fight.

examples.zh: 这个方案看似漂亮，其实是花拳绣腿。
examples.en: The plan looks good but is all show.

examples.zh: 真功夫要靠苦练，不能只练花拳绣腿。
examples.en: Real skill needs hard practice, not just showy moves.

usage.en: Noun or predicate; criticism of showy but weak skill.
usage.zh: 作名词或谓语，批评中看不中用。
